dataset.name: Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic), UCI WDBC (Wolberg, Mangasarian, Street, Street 1993; CC BY 4.0)
dataset.preprocessing_note: Table 2: 30 features, 455 / 114. The paper states neither the split nor the preprocessing; chosen: a stratified split (42 malignant + 72 benign test samples) from ChaCha20 seed 0, fixed for all runs, then per-column min-max scaling to [0, 1] with the training ranges (the tabular analogue of ReBoot's min-max scaling of MNIST). Standardization (z-score), the first choice, diverges at Table 8's lr: the training loss is NaN within epoch 1 for every seed (plain --scaling standardize; results/plain_bc_mlp_standardize.json; confirmed by an independent NumPy transcription on the training set only), because inputs of up to ~10 standard deviations pass through z^2 + z; the switch was decided on training-set divergence alone, before any test accuracy of min-max scaling was seen. Labels: malignant 0, benign 1 (scikit-learn's convention). `plain --split-seed per_run` draws a new split per run seed instead (reported as a sensitivity check).

model.name: eMLP-1 = RE-Block(32) (paper Table 3)
model.output_width_note: 2 classes, no padding (ReBoot's output padding for this data set is not stated; 2 is already a power of two).

config_file.name: bc_mlp

target.source: ReBoot paper (arXiv:2506.19693) Table 4, Breast Cancer eMLP-1, ReBoot column (plaintext, 10 runs): 99.03 ± 1.78

config_file.task: Task 51: Breast Cancer (UCI WDBC), ReBoot eMLP-1, plaintext twin against Table 4 (ReBoot column)

train.epochs_note: Not stated in the paper. Chosen before any run: 100 epochs (28 steps of 16 per epoch, 2800 updates); accuracy reported at epochs 10, 20, 50, 100 and at each seed's best epoch (test-set selected, optimistic).
train.hyperparameters_source: paper Table 8, Breast Cancer, ReBoot row, eMLP-1: lr 0.005, weight decay 0.0, batch 16

effective.init: Xavier uniform from ChaCha20 rng(seed, 2) (not ReBoot's draw)
effective.network: 30 -> 32 (z^2 + z) -> 2 (linear, 2 classes), no biases, Xavier uniform, MSE
effective.preprocessing: stratified split (455 train / 114 test, ChaCha20 rng(split_seed = 2, 4), data::stratified_split), then per-column min-max scaling with the training ranges (data::min_max_columns)
effective.shuffle: a fresh ChaCha20 permutation per epoch, rng(seed, 3)
effective.weight_decay_form: coupled (torch SGD: g += wd W before momentum and Nesterov)
